fields.help: get reads a session's messages; insert adds messages; delete removes the last N or all.
fields.label: Operation

fields.help: The conversation to use, resolved per item. The default reads the sessionId field a chat trigger puts on its items.
fields.label: Session Key

fields.help: simple: [{role, content}]. pairs: one {human, ai} entry per exchange. raw: also seq and created_at.
fields.label: Format

fields.help: One item per input item with messages and messagesCount (input fields kept), or one item per message.
fields.label: Group Messages

fields.help: append adds after the existing messages; override replaces the session with these.
fields.label: Insert Mode

fields.help: A list of {role, content}; role is human, ai or system (user and assistant are accepted). Both are resolved per item.
fields.label: Messages (JSON)

fields.help: How many of the newest messages delete removes (all of them when there are fewer).
fields.label: Messages to Delete
